scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const publicDir=path.join(root,'public'); const distDir=path.join(root,'frontend','dist'); const assetDir=path.join(publicDir,'assets'); if (fs.existsSync(assetDir)) fs.rmSync(assetDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); const indexPath=path.join(publicDir,'index.html'); if (fs.existsSync(indexPath)) fs.rmSync(indexPath); fs.cpSync(distDir, publicDir, { recursive: true });"
